how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format at Annexure - A of the notice, ticking the post applied for. Paste a recent passport size colour photograph and sign across it, and sign at the bottom of all pages.
Pay the application fee / intimation charges to the account below through Internet Banking / NEFT / RTGS / UPI, and write the Reference number / UTR Number in the application form.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below.
Put the application in a closed envelope super scribed "Application for the post of AI –Specialist Officers for AI Cell on Contractual Basis - 2026".
Send it to: Chief General Manager (CDO & CLO), Indian Bank, Corporate Office, HRM Department, Recruitment Section, 254-260, Avvai Shanmugam Salai, Royapettah, Chennai, Pin - 600 014, Tamil Nadu.
The application must reach this address on or before 1 December 2026. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.
An advance signed and scanned copy of the application may also be sent to [email protected].
Bank transaction charges, if any, must be borne by the candidate. A separate application and a separate fee payment are needed for each post applied for.
Proof of Date of Birth (the form asks for a copy of SSC / Birth Certificate)
Mark sheet and Passing certificate of all Educational, Technical / Professional qualifications/Certifications

Experience certificate(s) specifying designation / job profile, period of service (with specific dates), emoluments and activity profile of previous and present employers; the certificate must state that the candidate had experience in the related field as required
Photo Identity proof and Address proof

The form also asks for educational details, experience details as on 01.11.2026, the fee payment details and a signed declaration. Candidates need a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active during the process, as the Bank may send interview call letters by email.
important_instructions: An application without a proper visible passport size photograph, signature or fee payment details will be rejected. Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS on the application and supporting documents will not be accepted. Original certificates for qualifications, certifications, experience, age and category must be produced at the interview; otherwise the candidate will not be allowed for interview. Candidates in Govt. / quasi-Govt. organisations and public sector banks / undertakings must produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the interview and a proper discharge certificate before appointment. Requests to change contact number, address, email ID, interview centre, interview date and time or mode of interview will not be entertained. The Bank takes no responsibility for delay or loss in postal transit, and will not answer requests seeking advice on eligibility. Incorrect information or process violation leads to disqualification and a bar from future recruitment by the Bank; canvassing in any form is a disqualification. The Bank reserves the right to alter the eligibility criteria and terms, and to cancel the process partly or entirely without notice. Disputes are subject to the courts at Chennai. All further announcements will be published only on the career page of the Bank website www.indianbank.bank.in.

content_sections.heading: About Indian Bank
content_sections.text: Indian Bank describes itself in the notice as a leading Public Sector Bank and a Government of India undertaking, with headquarters in Chennai and a presence all over India and abroad. Its Corporate Office is at 254-260, Avvai Shanmugam Salai, Royapettah, Chennai – 600014. This engagement is for the Bank's AI Cell. The notice groups the posts into three roles: Functional AI Role (Business & Use-Case Leadership), Technical AI Roles (Architecture, Engineering & Platforms) and Risk, Audit & Governance Roles (Responsible AI & Compliance).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details (Post-wise and Category-wise)
content_sections.text: Indian Bank has notified 8 vacancies. The notice says the number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement of the Bank. The PwBD columns (VI, HI, OC, ID) show no vacancy for any post. The notice states that EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of the Government of India and the outcome of any litigation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration & Perquisites: Negotiable and not a limiting factor for deserving candidate. Period of Engagement: Fixed Term Employment (FTE) on contractual basis for an initial period of 3 years, extendable upto 5 years; to be renewed yearly or in less intervals subject to performance review, needs and requirements of the Bank. Leave: 30 days per calendar year on pro-rata basis. Leave balance will not be carried forward to subsequent years and no encashment of leave is permitted. Place of work: Chennai or as decided by the Bank. Termination of Contract: Three months' notice or three month's fixed component of the compensation in lieu thereof from either of the parties, at the sole discretion of the Bank. The engagement is governed by the contract and is not to be construed as an employment or a regular employment in the Bank; it ends automatically on completion of the contractual period. Engagement is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirements of the Bank, and to the Rules & Policies of the Bank.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Indian Bank Recruitment 2026 for AI Specialist Officers?
faq.answer: There are 8 provisional vacancies: 2 AVP - AI Product Manager, 1 VP - AI Engineer/ AI Architect, 1 DVP - AI Engineer/ AI Architect, 3 AVP - AI Engineer/ AI Architect and 1 AVP - Responsible AI Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The offline application with fee details must reach the Indian Bank Corporate Office, Chennai on or before 1 December 2026; late applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the AI Engineer/ AI Architect posts?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT / Data Science, or a Master's Degree (MTech. /MCA/MS) in AI/Machine Learning/Data Science/Analytics, plus any two of the listed certifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Indian Bank AI Specialist Officer posts?
faq.answer: As on 01.11.2026 it is 35 to 45 years for Vice President, 30 to 40 years for Deputy Vice President and 28 to 35 years for each Assistant Vice President post, with upper age relaxation such as 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Indian Bank AI Specialist Officers?
faq.answer: The notice gives no fixed amount; it says remuneration and perquisites are negotiable and not a limiting factor for deserving candidate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is Rs 175/- (inclusive of GST) for SC/ST/PwBD candidates and Rs 1000/- (inclusive of GST) for all other candidates, paid by Internet Banking / NEFT / RTGS / UPI to account 7422772966 (IFSC IDIB000R021).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Indian Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure - A form with self-attested documents in a closed envelope super scribed "Application for the post of AI –Specialist Officers for AI Cell on Contractual Basis - 2026" to the Chief General Manager (CDO & CLO), Indian Bank, Corporate Office, Royapettah, Chennai - 600 014; an advance scanned copy may be emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised by a Screening Committee and shortlisted candidates are interviewed by a Selection Committee; a Written Test, Group Discussion or Preliminary interview may be added if applicants are substantially large.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job in Indian Bank?
faq.answer: No. It is Fixed Term Employment on contractual basis for an initial 3 years, extendable upto 5 years, renewed yearly or in less intervals subject to performance review.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, if you meet the eligibility for each post, but you must submit a separate application and pay a separate fee for each post.
